scripts.dev: tsx scripts/prepare-dev.ts && pnpm db:prepare && pnpm --filter @mathstudy/web dev
scripts.db:migrate:local: pnpm --filter @mathstudy/web exec wrangler d1 migrations apply mathstudy-prod-db --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: pnpm --filter @mathstudy/web exec wrangler d1 migrations apply mathstudy-prod-db --remote
scripts.db:seed:local: tsx scripts/generate-seed.ts && pnpm --filter @mathstudy/web exec wrangler d1 execute mathstudy-prod-db --local --file ../../tmp/d1/seed.sql --yes
scripts.db:seed:remote: tsx scripts/generate-seed.ts && pnpm --filter @mathstudy/web exec wrangler d1 execute mathstudy-prod-db --remote --file ../../tmp/d1/seed.sql --yes
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: pnpm db:migrate:remote && pnpm db:seed:remote && pnpm --filter @mathstudy/web exec wrangler deploy && pnpm smoke
scripts.lint: prettier --check apps packages content tests scripts *.json *.yaml && node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages content tests scripts *.json *.yaml
